title: Figure 5: RavenWindow and RavenLight smart window filters in cold and hot states
description: Composite of five color photographs showing samples of RavenBrick's thermoreflective window film: a gloved hand holding a tinted film sheet, a framed glass sample, a window filter in front of a soda can, and two pairs of framed panes comparing a city view through clear versus reflective film. The caption reads "Figure 5. Assorted Views of RavenWindow and RavenLight Filters in the Cold (Transparent) and Hot (Reflective) State." The page sits in a section titled "Early Commercialization of Smart Materials" in a document marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY.
